The '''Science Service''' was a branch of [[Corulag Academy]] that focused upon [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] research. It was housed its own [[Science Service tower|tower]] and was lead by [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Frexton]].
